### Layer Dependency (Clean Architecture direction)
`API → Services → Infrastructure (Interfaces) → Models`

- **Models** — Zero dependencies. Contains `ProductEntity`, `ProductDto`, `CreateProductRequest`.
- **Infrastructure** — References `Models`. Uses **Dapper** + **Microsoft.Data.SqlClient**.

- **API** — References all three. Uses DI to wire up services.

## 🔒 Security: Connection String from Environment Variable

**`DapperContext.cs`** — The connection string is **never** in `appsettings.json`. It is loaded exclusively from the `DB_CONNECTION_STRING` environment variable:

```csharp
public DapperContext()
{
    var connStr = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DB_CONNECTION_STRING")
        ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("The environment variable 'DB_CONNECTION_STRING' is not set.");
    _connectionString = connStr;
}
```

For **local development**, it's set in `launchSettings.json` (which is `.gitignore`-friendly):

```json
"environmentVariables": {
    "DB_CONNECTION_STRING": "Server=.;Database=MyAppDb;Trusted_Connection=True;TrustServerCertificate=True;"
}
```

For **production**, set it at the OS/container level:
- **Windows**: `setx DB_CONNECTION_STRING "..."` 
- **Linux**: `export DB_CONNECTION_STRING="..."`
- **Docker**: `-e DB_CONNECTION_STRING="..."`

Every dependency is interface-based:
- `IProductRepository` — can be mocked in unit tests for `ProductService`
- `IProductService` — can be mocked in unit tests for `ProductController`
- `DapperContext` — can be replaced with an in-memory mock for integration-style tests

All database calls use **stored procedures** with **DynamicParameters**:

```csharp
public async Task<ProductEntity?> GetByIdAsync(int id)
{

    parameters.Add("@Id", id);
    return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<ProductEntity>(
        sql: "sp_GetProductById",
        param: parameters,
        commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure
    );
}
```

Repository Pattern — Dapper + Stored Procedures

// Interface (để Service chỉ phụ thuộc abstraction)
public interface ICategoryRepository
{
    Task<IEnumerable<InfoCategoryEntity>> GetAllAsync();
    Task<InfoCategoryEntity?> GetByIdAsync(int id);
    Task<InfoCategoryEntity> CreateAsync(InfoCategoryEntity entity);
    Task<InfoCategoryEntity?> UpdateAsync(InfoCategoryEntity entity);
    Task<bool> DeleteAsync(int id);
}

// Implementation (Dapper)
public sealed class CategoryRepository : ICategoryRepository
{
    private readonly DapperContext _context;

    public CategoryRepository(DapperContext context) { _context = context; }

    public async Task<InfoCategoryEntity?> GetByIdAsync(int id)
    {
        using var connection = _context.CreateConnection();
        var parameters = new DynamicParameters();
        parameters.Add("@CategoryId", id);

        return await connection.QuerySingleOrDefaultAsync<InfoCategoryEntity>(
            sql: "API_InfoCategory_GetById",
            param: parameters,
            commandType: CommandType.StoredProcedure
        );
    }
    // ... các method khác tương tự
}

3. Services Layer (Business Logic)

Service chịu trách nhiệm:

  • Gọi Repository để lấy/gửi dữ liệu
  • Map Entity thành DTO (che giấu DB schema khỏi client)
  • Xử lý nghiệp vụ (nếu có logic phức tạp)
public sealed class CategoryService : ICategoryService
{
    private readonly ICategoryRepository _repository;

    public CategoryService(ICategoryRepository repository)
    {
        _repository = repository;    // Inject Interface — dễ mock
    }

    public async Task<InfoCategoryDto?> GetByIdAsync(int id)
    {
        var entity = await _repository.GetByIdAsync(id);
        return entity is null ? null : MapToDto(entity);
    }

    public async Task<InfoCategoryDto> CreateAsync(CreateCategoryRequest request)
    {
        var entity = new InfoCategoryEntity
        {
            CategoryName = request.CategoryName,
            Description = request.Description,
            SortOrder = request.SortOrder,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
        };
        var created = await _repository.CreateAsync(entity);
        return MapToDto(created);
    }

    private static InfoCategoryDto MapToDto(InfoCategoryEntity entity)
    {
        return new InfoCategoryDto(
            CategoryId: entity.CategoryId,
            CategoryName: entity.CategoryName,
            Description: entity.Description,
            SortOrder: entity.SortOrder,
            IsActive: entity.IsActive,
            CreatedAt: entity.CreatedAt
        );
    }
}

using _2026_web_api_01.Infrastructure.Data;

builder.Services.AddSingleton<DapperContext>();         // 1 instance cho cả app
builder.Services.AddScoped<IProductRepository,     ProductRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICategoryRepository,    CategoryRepository>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IInformationRepository, InformationRepository>();

// ─── APPLICATION / BUSINESS LAYER ───
builder.Services.AddScoped<IProductService,     ProductService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<ICategoryService,    CategoryService>();
builder.Services.AddScoped<IInformationService, InformationService>();

// ─── ASP.NET CORE BUILT-IN ───
builder.Services.AddControllers();
builder.Services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();

// Middleware pipeline

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.MapControllers();
app.Run();

Giải thích DI Scopes:

  • Singleton — 1 instance duy nhất cho toàn bộ ứng dụng (DapperContext không trạng thái)
  • Scoped — 1 instance mỗi HTTP request (Repository, Service)
  • Transient — không dùng ở đây, mỗi lần inject là 1 instance mới

[Fact]
public async Task GetByIdAsync_ReturnsDto_WhenEntityExists()

    {

    };
    mockRepo.Setup(r => r.GetByIdAsync(1))
